answer: In a distributed AI agent economy, Sybil attacks are countered by requiring verifiable compute-bound tasks. Like the conduct of copper, electricity must flow to validate work, making fake identities costly to manufacture. A zephyr of truth validates the network, ensuring that every whisper of activity is backed by genuine resources. By linking identity to resource consumption, an attacker faces exponential costs for every fraudulent persona added, effectively securing the ledger against malicious saturation.
